ms-municipal-officeholders.summary: This app can tell you which Mississippi city, town or village you are in, and not who your mayor or council members are.
ms-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of Mississippi's mayors and council or board members has been read yet. The boundary this card draws carries geography and no officeholder at all, and this app never guesses a name.
ms-municipal-officeholders.wanted: A statewide roster of mayors and council or board members by ward, or each city's own published list.

ms-school-board-members.summary: This app names your school district and not the people on its board.
ms-school-board-members.why: No statewide list of Mississippi's school board members has been found. The boundary this card draws carries the district's name and nothing about its board.
ms-school-board-members.wanted: A statewide roster of school board members, or each district's own published list of its board.

ms-supervisor-district-lines.area: Mississippi — the counties whose current supervisor district lines are not confirmed
ms-supervisor-district-lines.summary: In most Mississippi counties this app names all five supervisors but cannot show which one represents the spot you picked, because it has no confirmed map of the current district lines there.
ms-supervisor-district-lines.why: The Census Bureau's map still carries the lines from before the 2020 census in most counties, and no state office publishes the current ones. Old lines would name the wrong supervisor for many people, so none are drawn.
ms-supervisor-district-lines.wanted: Each county's current supervisor district map, or one statewide map of every county's current lines from a state office.
